blocks.html: Unique Education and Migration Service, Mumbai held a seminar at Garodia International School on 20th September 2018, We addressed the Year 11 and Year 12 students about the opportunities for studying further in Australia. There were many students who have been thinking about studying in many different fields such as sports management etc, and what better place to do a course like that.
Our Councellors were able to address all the questions individually and will continue to provide guidance.
